item.title: Voters are sick of the two-party system. A new poll shows they're open to big changes
item.description: A new poll shows support for moving the U.S. toward proportional representation, a system that elects multiple representatives in a single district in rough proportion to a party's vote share.
item.content:encoded:
A new poll shows support for moving the U.S. toward proportional representation, a system that elects multiple representatives in a single district in rough proportion to a party's vote share.

item.title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
item.description: Lindell, of "MyPillow," plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents.

item.title: An arts school where Epstein allegedly preyed on students reveals decades of abuse
item.description: In a new report, former Interlochen students detail some 70 allegations of sexual abuse by nearly 50 adults employed or affiliated with the school. One of the former students tells his story to NPR.

item.title: In a competitive Maine Senate race, women voters could be the deciders
item.description: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of this year's most high-profile Senate contests. To win, both candidates will need support from an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.

item.title: The FAA wants to reboot the nation's airspace. This airline shows how it might work
item.description: When Alaska Airlines wanted to optimize its operations, it turned to a small startup called Air Space Intelligence. Now the FAA has hired the company for a major reboot of the entire U.S. airspace.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Nizhnekamsk kills 12, authorities say
item.description: Ukraine has targeted Russian oil facilities with long-range drones almost daily in recent months. The barrage has caused fuel shortages in Russia and unsettled the Russian public.

item.title: Crews battle wildfires in western U.S. and Canada
item.description: There have been 183 new wildfires, including eight large ones, across the U.S. since Saturday, the National Interagency Fire Center reported on Sunday.
